added_lines: kil toghert women’s group: will have a representive from citizen’s information, on wednesday 28th october at 8.30pm. all welcome kiltoghert pioneers: the annual remembrance mass for deceased members of the kiltoghert centre is scheduled for friday 27th november in st. mary's church at 8 pm. the carrick/longford regional remembrance mass is scheduled for friday 6th november at the church of blessed virgin, newtowncashel, county longford, at 8 pm. the here, fr. merlyn kenny, was a former spiritual director of the kiltoghert centre and guided us successfully through our centenary celebrations in 2014. successful regional pioneer dinner dance: the annual dinner-dance of the carrick & longford regional pioneers was held in the rustic inn, abbeyshrule on friday night last. up to 100 attended from all centres in both regions and were served up a sumptuous 4-course meal followed by a dance the music for the same was provided by séamus farrell (longford). 3 leitrim centres from kiltoghert, drumshanbo and kiltubrid were well represented at this eagerly looked-forward-to social event for pioneers. leitrim county council : mass for members and deceased members will be celebrated on monday 2nd nov., in st. mary’s church at 8pm matthew 22:34-40 throughout scripture, the emphasis on our obligation to love is unambiguous. to love god, to love our neighbour, and yes, to love ourselves, is the core of the old testament covenant and also the call of jesus. compassion, generosity, and forgiveness are the nature of this love. love is not simply an emotion, it is action. love is walking the extra mile, giving from our poverty, listening to the tedious, caring for the helpless, welcoming the stranger. love calls us to live as if the kingdom of god were already here and, by doing so, to make it a reality. love demands us to go beyond our basic instinct of self-preservation to serve the needs of others. carrick-on-shannon (kiltoghert)
